gap: No result ChatGPT got states that eufy's own US store now sells the SoloCam E50, the next generation of the S340 (dual 4K lenses, mmWave radar, 5 W panel, dual-band Wi-Fi), for $229.99. That is $10 more than eufy's own $219.99 for the S340, and $70 more than the $159.99 Abt price on ChatGPT's 'best overall' card.
standout_why: I compared against the two cited pages, rottenwifi.com/best-solar-powered-home-security-cameras-for-2026 and reolink.com/blog/solar-powered-security-cameras-buying-guide. Rottenwifi prices the S340 at $159.99 and lists it as 2.4 GHz only, but it never mentions the E50 and gives a price for only one of the cards ChatGPT showed. Reolink's guide gives no prices at all, and neither page has a Tapo C660 price or any multi-pack price per camera. I didn't open the uncited results (safewise, bobvila, homegearlab and others), so one of them may mention the E50.
decides: If the shopper can buy the S340 at Abt's $159.99, it stays the cheapest of the pan-tilt picks, though it is 3K and 2.4 GHz only. If they would pay eufy's list price, the E50 at $229.99 makes the S340 a poor buy. For a fixed view, Amazon's $134.99 for the Argus 4 Pro with its panel undercuts Newegg's $179.99 card by $45. For a pan-tilt camera, Tapo's own 2-pack brings the C660 Kit down to $124.99 per camera.
